input.subject: Window locks – Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews (ref R/012)
input.body:
Dear Perrin,

Re: window sash locks and keys at Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews, Orellin ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/012).

Keypath Repairs have told us they attended on Friday 19 September and carried out the lock work. We have no visit record yet, so could you please confirm:
1. Did anyone from Keypath Repairs come to the property (on 19 September or any other day)?
2. Do the bedroom and bathroom sash locks now work, and do you now have keys for the bedroom, bathroom and kitchen sashes?

Also, you mentioned mould appearing in the bathroom when we spoke on 9 September. Is it still there? If you can, please send a photo and let us know roughly how big the area is, so we can look at it separately.

We will follow up with you on Saturday 27 September if we haven't heard back by then.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Invoice and visit details – Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews (ref R/012)
input.body:
Dear Edrin,

Re: window sash locks at Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews, Orellin ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/012).

Thank you for the call today. We still can't see an invoice on file. When you send it, please also include:
- the date and time you attended, and how you got in (on 17 September you told us you hadn't collected the management keys and hadn't found the tenant at home);
- what was done to each window (bedroom sash lock, bathroom sash and locking buttons, kitchen sash), and how many keys were supplied and who has them;
- an itemised breakdown of parts and labour.

We need these details to check the invoice against the job before we pass it to the landlord.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

The tenant can settle this quickly, so I asked them rather than escalating. Paying or forwarding an invoice would need proof the work was done and a check of the amount, especially as the landlord set no cost limit (event 003).
